requirements.name: Historical daily Bitcoin prices
requirements.html_location: Bitcoin in dollars; Sources & audit trail
requirements.evidence: 5,789 consecutive daily Coin Metrics PriceUSD observations, 2010-07-18 to 2026-05-23. October extension unverified because proxy denied newer-source requests.

requirements.name: Interactive actual-price dollar graph
requirements.evidence: Hover, zoom, date ranges, linear/log dollar axis; actuals shown by default.

requirements.name: Log-price linear regression and 95% confidence band
requirements.html_location: The natural logarithm of price; Independent regression and back-transformation audit
requirements.evidence: OLS; selectable classical IID Student-t and Newey–West HAC 90-lag normal mean-log intervals, with independently verified covariance and endpoints.

requirements.name: November 2030 forecast converted to USD
requirements.evidence: 2030-11-01 dated estimate exp(16.364785440061567) = 12,797,820.488576526 USD under full-history fit, with November 30 also reported.

requirements.name: Reliability and uncertainty
requirements.evidence: Confidence vs prediction intervals, sample-window sensitivity, residual dependence, holdout failure and explicit lack of calibrated future-price probabilities.

requirements.name: Data sources and methodology
requirements.evidence: Coin Metrics attribution and license; immutable Git commit URL; raw CSV SHA-256; data exclusion rules; formulas; independent audit downloads; documented network limitations.
